scope: Per-device serialized FanAndLighting coordinator connected to actor tree; durable commit/receipt before both silent installs and first Apply. Explicit reapply and transfer IPC/CLI/GUI remain pending.

contract.order: Both freeze ACKs -> owner receipt admission -> both preflight ACKs -> sealed durable owner commit -> both install ACKs -> both Apply responses -> release. Settings owner outlives coordinator teardown. No settings deltas produced by install/Apply.
contract.idempotency: Repeated operation ID verifies kind/original source SHA/original expected revision and returns receipt/current state without import/Apply. Later manual/RGB edits remain intact. Stale CAS known rejection releases previous runtime; reuse of committed ID with different expected parameters rejected.
contract.outcome: Storage acknowledgement separated from runtime errors. Known HID failures preserve committed desired intent and per-channel/zone errors; release permits new corrections. Lost client reply does not cancel accepted operation. Lost owner reply/RecoveryRequired/partial install admission ambiguity seals both actors and blocks coordinator mutations until whole device-tree/daemon recovery/restart.
contract.shutdown: Before commit no import. Accepted owner commit joined even if caller disappears/shutdown arrives; observed shutdown after receipt defers Apply. Queued imports drained with errors, no second receipt.
contract.limits: No public group transfer IPC/CLI/GUI or explicit reapply yet. Extended partial install, lifecycle/contended/cancel, restart qualification and legacy manual0 semantics remain open.

regression.coverage: Actual group codec, settings owner/durable stores and sole cooling/RGB actors; private fake HID. All4 initial config writes observe stored receipt. Held RGB install ACK proves zero Apply beforehand. Client reply drop still finishes. Lost real-owner commit ACK leaves durable65/73 and receipt while both actors reject setters and no Apply; shutdown flush retains committed snapshot. Corrupt journal remains untouched and original device.toml bytes unchanged after teardown. Later manual42/green preserved on duplicate, stale CAS resumes old44 then fresh retry65; changed parameters rejected. Global thermal/neighbor LCD81/sparse Fan2 and Pump1 slots preserved. HID errors return independently of durable success. Shutdown after owner commit with queued import yields one receipt/revision and zero writes.

plans.deleted: none: all active plans still contain open requirements

checks.hardware: NOT RUN: user explicitly deferred; private fake HID and temp stores only

Group transfer IPC/CLI/GUI and Windows archive mapping
Legacy unset versus explicit manual PWM0, full fan+lighting reset, desktop/platform/packaging/checklist items
Additional LCD effects and Style Express last; hardware acceptance deferred
